about_short_description.short_description: The Giving Movement is an online store that sells sustainable activewear and streetwear clothing.

product.name: Recycled Lightweight Lounge Collection
product.description: A range of men's activewear including T-shirts, joggers, and shorts made from recycled lightweight fabric.

product.name: GCC Bestsellers Kids Collection
product.description: A selection of children's clothing including hoodies, sweatpants, tops, leggings, and accessories made from organic and recycled fabrics.

product.name: Kids Graphic Prints Collection
product.description: Children's clothing featuring graphic prints on organic cotton and recycled fabrics, including T-shirts, leggings, joggers, and shorts.

product.name: Men's Graphic Prints Collection
product.description: Men's clothing with graphic prints on organic cotton and recycled fabrics, including T-shirts, shorts, and joggers.

product.name: Women's Graphic Prints Collection
product.description: Women's activewear and streetwear featuring graphic prints on organic cotton and recycled fabrics, including T-shirts, biker shorts, and leggings.

product.name: Amal's Closet Collection
product.description: A women's clothing line featuring sweatpants, leggings, jackets, tops, and long sleeves made from organic cotton and recycled fabrics.
